essence: Protection of the head and forehead is sought from the yakshini and the yaksha maiden.
Protection of the eyes and nose is sought from the boon-giver and the devotee-affectionate goddess.
Protection of the shoulders and throat is sought from the family protector and the lotus-faced goddess.
Constant protection is sought from the distorted-faced goddess beloved of the great crooked one.
Protection of the heart is sought from the goddesses Bherunda and Makari, approved by the gods.
